status: development analysis; final holdout remains unopened
income_ranking_population: all 100 NC counties with positive B19013 estimates
income_groups: tertiles at linear-interpolated quantiles 1/3 and 2/3; boundary ties assigned to lower group
eligibility: 129 positive nonmissing monthly ZHVI observations in the development period; positive 2019 income and nonnegative margin of error
selection: all eligible counties; no filtering on forecast performance or final-holdout values
ml_strategy: one pooled model per regressor/configuration across all eligible counties; county-specific differencing and standardization fitted within each training window
primary_model_selection_metric: equal-county mean MAE relative to each county's naive baseline
affordability_comparison: 2019 and 2024 annual mean ZHVI divided by respective ACS five-year median household income, an endpoint proxy with mismatched observation windows
